name: dir-hygiene-lints-ci-clean-red
title: 三条目录 lint 接 CI + 清 gap_triage_batch2c 红(裁决九.5 UNHEALED)
description: 源:裁决九.5 卫生自查=UNHEALED(三条目录 lint)。拦截能力本身合格(self-test 全绿、三注入全拦 sealed写/非法文件/canon非总纲、fail-closed 生效),但判据两处硬缺:(1) CI 不常跑:三 lint(check_experiments_layout.py/check_docs_canon.py/check_index_consistency.py)脚本头自称 '(CI, fail-closed)' 但全仓 grep(.github/、Makefile、.pre-commit-config、.git/hooks/)命中=0;唯一 workflow falsifier-gate.yml 只跑 schema.def 门,从不调这三条——守卫在门上却没接电。(2) 活树已 RED:因无 CI 常跑,腐烂沉积——① check_experiments_layout RED(exit1):12 个未注册代码工件(sweep.c/threeway*.c/ours_emitc_c/*.cpp)泄漏进数据格 experiments/active/format-micro-rvv-vlen128/gap_triage_batch2c/;③ check_index_consistency RED(exit1):同格 32 处'present in cell but NOT registered in MANIFEST'漂移。修复项:1) 接线:给三 lint 加 CI job(并入 falsifier-gate.yml 或新建 .github/workflows/dir-hygiene.yml),on pull_request+push 跑 check_experiments_layout.py/check_docs_canon.py/check_index_consistency.py{各 --self-test + 审计}+gen_experiments_index.py --check,全 fail-closed。2) 清红:gap_triage_batch2c/ 下把 harness/代码(sweep.c/threeway*.c/ours_emitc_c/*.cpp)git mv 进 tools/,把 disasm/*.objdump.txt、*_triage*.txt 等真证据注册进 owning cell experiments/active/format-micro-rvv-vlen128/MANIFEST.md(或建子格 MANIFEST),使 ① 与 ③ 回 GREEN。注:清红动 experiments//tools/ 属并行线,须与并行线协调后串行执行。P1=G1 收口宣布前置件。
creator: claude
